description: Localization service interface for Tempo.Blazor components. Provides translated strings based on resource keys. The library ships English, Czech and French. Counted texts use Loc.Plural (Key_One/_Few/_Many/_Other, see TmLocalizerPluralExtensions); Culture and TryGetString are default interface members, so existing implementations keep compiling.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Gets the localized string for the specified key.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Gets the localized string with format arguments.
